safety_limits: sanitized metadata and synthetic fixtures only
no GitHub mutation, runtime connection, SQL execution, backup, restore, deployment, or production operation
candidate/static evidence does not establish reachability, runtime behavior, authorization, recovery success, RPO, or RTO
all product/runtime/CI results remain NOT_RUN until an eligible fenced lease and required environments exist
title: Isolated backup, restore and recovery evidence checklist

verified_static_baseline.meaning: dump evidence only; current runtime must be rechecked

required_rehearsal_record: source environment identity and approved scope
backup identity/type/time/hash or provider-native immutable ID
disposable restore target and isolation proof
integrity result and application smoke result
data-loss observation compared with an agreed target
prohibited_claims: no production restore or SQL option change
no point-in-time recovery assumption under SIMPLE
no success inferred from backup creation alone
no customer/transaction payload in public evidence

cases.synthetic_trigger: runtime options differ from the historical dump
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: authorized live option capture with environment/build/database identity

cases.synthetic_trigger: backup exists but source identity or chain is unknown
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: do not restore or claim recoverability
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: verified backup sequence compatible with the current recovery model and provider policy; under SIMPLE, no transaction-log chain assumption

cases.synthetic_trigger: restore target can route to shared/customer resources
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: network/account/database isolation proof and DBA approval

cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: withhold success until integrity and application smoke checks pass
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: DB integrity result plus scoped read/auth/application checks

cases.synthetic_trigger: team derives RPO/RTO from one elapsed restore
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: report only observed timings and data-loss window
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: owner-approved targets plus repeated representative measurements

cases.synthetic_trigger: point-in-time recovery is requested while evidence says SIMPLE
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: mark unsupported pending verified backup policy
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: current recovery model and provider backup/log capability evidence

cases.synthetic_trigger: credentials or live data would enter logs/artifacts
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: redact and store only sanctioned metadata
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: secret scan and sanitized evidence review

cases.synthetic_trigger: restore uses a newer/older incompatible application or schema
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: quarantine result until compatibility is proven
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: build/config/schema manifest and compatibility smoke suite

cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: retain failed evidence and clean isolated resources safely
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: failure log, resource inventory and verified cleanup

cases.synthetic_trigger: backup/restore succeeds once but no reviewer verifies exact artifacts
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: independent exact-evidence review and repeatability record

cases.synthetic_trigger: SIMPLE database has full plus differential backup but no SQL log backups
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: evaluate the verified compatible sequence; do not fail merely for missing log chain and do not claim PITR
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: current recovery model, actual backup types/order and successful isolated restore

cases.synthetic_trigger: business database restores later than command ledger
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: disable dispatch and reconcile operations at a safe common frontier before reuse
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: business/ledger checkpoint mapping and duplicate/OutcomeUnknown reconciliation test

cases.synthetic_trigger: business database restores but audit/outbox state is older or newer
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: withhold normal operation; reconcile missing/duplicate audit and event delivery without fabricating history
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: audit/outbox frontier map, replay/dedup policy and reviewer evidence

cases.synthetic_trigger: report job/artifact metadata points beyond restored business/config frontier
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: quarantine status/download and regenerate only under current authorization and reviewed snapshot semantics
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: job/artifact/config frontier and authorized reconciliation test

backup_chain_policy.runtime_rule: re-read current recovery model and provider backup capabilities before selecting evidence requirements
backup_chain_policy.SIMPLE: require a verified restorable full backup and any compatible differential/provider-native chain actually used; do not require or claim SQL transaction-log chain or point-in-time recovery
backup_chain_policy.FULL_OR_BULK_LOGGED: log-chain/PITR acceptance applies only if the current runtime policy and actual backup sequence prove it
backup_chain_policy.universal: every artifact/sequence has immutable identity, source, timestamps, integrity and restore-order evidence; a chain type is never guessed

restore_frontier.rule: choose one reviewed recovery frontier that prevents replay, duplicate effects, missing audit and false event/report completion; independent store restores are not assumed atomic
required_dispositions: post-restore reconciliation owner and blocked-dispatch state
